Providing script to fetch each August day page’s last revision prior to end of June 2023 and parse references:

```python
import requests, re
import mwparserfromhell

S = requests.Session()
API = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"
PAGES = [f"August {i}" for i in range(1, 32)]
CUTOFF = "2023-06-30T23:59:59Z"

TW_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"https?://(?:www\.)?twitter\.com/[^/]+/status/\d+", re.I),
    re.compile(r"https?://(?:www\.)?x\.com/[^/]+/status/\d+", re.I),
]
ARCHIVE_PAT = re.compile(r"https?://web\.archive\.org/.+/(https?://(?:www\.)?(?:twitter\.com|x\.com)/[^/]+/status/\d+)", re.I)

counts = {}

for title in PAGES:
    # Get the last revision at or before cutoff
    params = {
        "action": "query",
        "prop": "revisions",
        "titles": title,
        "rvlimit": 1,
        "rvdir": "older",
        "rvstart": CUTOFF,
        "rvprop": "content|timestamp"
    }
    r = S.get(API, params=params)
    data = r.json()
    pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
    page = next(iter(pages.values()))
    revs = page.get("revisions", [])
    if not revs:
        counts[title] = 0
        continue
    wikitext = revs[0].get("*", "") if "*" in revs[0] else revs[0].get("slots", {}).get("main", {}).get("*", "")
    wikicode = mwparserfromhell.parse(wikitext)
    refs = [str(t) for t in wikicode.filter_tags(matches=lambda t: t.tag == "ref")]
    c = 0
    for ref in refs:
        # raw match
        if any(p.search(ref) for p in TW_PATTERNS):
            c += 1
            continue
        # archive match
        if ARCHIVE_PAT.search(ref):
            c += 1
            continue
    counts[title] = c

print(counts)
print("TOTAL:", sum(counts.values()))
```

import requests

from collections import Counter

S = requests.Session()

cite_tweet_counts = {}

for title in PAGES:
    params = {"action":"query","prop":"revisions","titles":title,"rvlimit":1,"rvprop":"content","formatversion":2}

    data = r.json()

    cite_tweet_counts[title] = c
